entries.en: Her work in agrometeorology kept her travelling between the weather station and nearby wheat fields.
entries.zh: 她从事农业气象学工作，因此常往返于气象站和附近的麦田之间。

entries.en: Her agromicrobiology project examined microbes in soil from the school garden.
entries.zh: 她的农业微生物学项目研究了学校花园土壤中的微生物。

entries.en: The agronome questioned our choice of seed before inspecting the trial plots.
entries.zh: 那位农艺学家先对我们的种子选择提出疑问，随后才检查试验田。

entries.en: She sketched the exposed soil layers for her assignment in agropedology.
entries.zh: 她画下裸露的土层，作为农业土壤学作业的一部分。

entries.en: The agrostologist asked us to preserve the flowering stems with the specimens.
entries.zh: 那位禾本植物学家让我们把开花的茎秆连同标本一起保存。

entries.en: An agrotechnician helped the farmers investigate uneven watering across the field.
entries.zh: 一位农业技术员帮助农民调查了田地各处浇水不均的问题。

entries.en: Aguayo covered the bread before opening the dusty cupboard.
entries.zh: 阿瓜约先把面包盖好，才打开那个积灰的橱柜。

entries.en: Aguda volunteered to drive the empty van back after the move.
entries.zh: 搬家结束后，阿古达主动提出把空货车开回去。

entries.en: Agueda tied a bright ribbon around her suitcase handle.
entries.zh: 阿格达在行李箱把手上系了一条鲜艳的丝带。

entries.en: Aguiar waited until the applause ended before introducing the next speaker.
entries.zh: 阿吉亚尔等掌声结束后，才介绍下一位发言者。

entries.en: Aguila put the broken umbrella aside and borrowed mine.
entries.zh: 阿吉拉把坏雨伞放到一边，借走了我的。

entries.en: Aguilera suggested putting the children's drawings beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 阿奎莱拉建议把孩子们的画放在入口旁。

entries.en: Aguru collected the spare name badges after the workshop ended.
entries.zh: 研习班结束后，腾收起了多余的姓名牌。

entries.en: Agusta cleared a space on the bench for the wet boots.
entries.zh: 阿古斯塔在长凳上清出一块地方，放那些湿靴子。

entries.en: Agustin folded the chairs while we carried the tables indoors.
entries.zh: 我们往屋里搬桌子时，阿古斯丁把椅子折叠了起来。

entries.en: Agustina realised that her umbrella was still on the bus.
entries.zh: 阿古斯蒂纳发现自己的雨伞还在公交车上。

entries.en: Ahad brought a larger bowl when the fruit would not fit.
entries.zh: 水果装不下时，阿哈德拿来了一个更大的碗。

entries.en: Aharon stopped the trolley before it rolled into the flower display.
entries.zh: 阿哈龙在推车滑进鲜花展台前把它拦住了。

entries.en: Ahava found the missing glove inside a folded shopping bag.
entries.zh: 阿哈瓦在一个折好的购物袋里找到了丢失的手套。

entries.en: Ahearn lent me a lamp while the ceiling light was being repaired.
entries.zh: 修理顶灯期间，埃亨借给了我一盏台灯。

entries.en: Ahlberg spread old towels beneath the leaking window.
entries.zh: 阿尔伯格在漏水的窗户下面铺了几条旧毛巾。

entries.en: Ahlborn packed the photographs between two stiff pieces of cardboard.
entries.zh: 阿尔博恩把照片夹在两块硬纸板之间包好了。

entries.en: Ahluwalia asked for a quieter table away from the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 阿卢瓦利亚要求换到一张远离厨房门的安静餐桌。

entries.en: Ahmadi noticed a loose screw before sitting on the folding chair.
entries.zh: 坐上那把折叠椅之前，艾哈迈迪发现有颗螺丝松了。

entries.en: Ahman brought the laundry indoors when the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 刚下起雨，阿曼就把晾着的衣服收进了屋。

entries.en: Ahmann replaced the old batteries and the clock began ticking again.
entries.zh: 阿曼换掉旧电池，钟又开始滴答作响了。

entries.en: Ahmat fetched a cloth after spilling water beside the computer.
entries.zh: 艾哈迈德把水洒在电脑旁后，拿来了一块布。

entries.en: Ahmer stepped outside to take the call without interrupting our rehearsal.
entries.zh: 艾哈迈尔走到外面接电话，免得打断我们的排练。

entries.en: Ahonen offered to keep the spare keys until we returned.
entries.zh: 阿霍宁提出帮我们保管备用钥匙，直到我们回来。

entries.en: Ahrens put the fragile cups on the lowest shelf.
entries.zh: 阿伦斯把那些易碎的杯子放在了最下面一层架子上。

entries.en: Ahsan borrowed a smaller brush to paint around the window frame.
entries.zh: 阿赫桑借了一把小一些的刷子，给窗框周围刷漆。

entries.en: An Ahtna artist joined our workshop and brought several sketches.
entries.zh: 一位阿特纳族艺术家带着几张素描，来参加我们的研习班。

entries.en: Ahuja found that the spare mattress fitted neatly beneath the bed.
entries.zh: 阿胡贾发现备用床垫正好能放进床底。

entries.en: Ahumada drew a simple map to help us find the rehearsal room.
entries.zh: 阿乌马达画了张简图，帮我们找到排练室。

entries.en: Aiah borrowed my scarf when the wind grew colder.
entries.zh: 风变冷时，阿亚借走了我的围巾。

entries.en: Aicha covered the piano before the painters arrived.
entries.zh: 油漆工来之前，艾莎把钢琴罩了起来。

entries.en: Without the villagers' aidance, the travellers could not have crossed the flooded valley.
entries.zh: 没有村民的帮助，那些旅人就无法穿过被洪水淹没的山谷。

entries.en: Aidin placed the heavy parcel where nobody would trip over it.
entries.zh: 艾丁把那个沉重的包裹放在了不会绊倒别人的地方。

entries.en: The aidman waited beside the ambulance while the convoy assembled.
entries.zh: 车队集合时，那名救护兵在救护车旁等候。

entries.en: Two aidmen carried a stretcher out of the field hospital.
entries.zh: 两名救护兵从野战医院里抬出了一副担架。

entries.en: Aidos returned with enough clean mugs for the whole group.
entries.zh: 艾多斯拿回了足够全组人用的干净马克杯。

entries.en: Aiello turned the music down so we could hear the announcement.
entries.zh: 艾洛把音乐调低，好让我们听清广播通知。

entries.en: The shop assistant put the Aigo box in a plain paper bag.
entries.zh: 店员把爱国者品牌的盒子装进了一个普通纸袋。

entries.en: Clouds hid the aiguille until we reached the far side of the lake.
entries.zh: 直到我们到达湖的另一边，云雾才不再遮住那座针状岩峰。

entries.meaningZh: 肩带〔军服绳饰，法语借词〕
entries.en: The officer's aiguillette caught on the chair as he stood up.
entries.zh: 军官站起来时，军服上的肩带绳饰钩住了椅子。

entries.en: Aikens put a folded blanket under the rocking chair.
entries.zh: 艾肯斯在摇椅下面垫了一条折好的毯子。

entries.en: Aikin checked that the back door was locked before leaving.
entries.zh: 离开前，艾金检查了一下后门是否锁好。

entries.en: Aiko carried the birthday cake through the doorway without tilting it.
entries.zh: 爱子端着生日蛋糕穿过门口，没有让蛋糕倾斜。

entries.en: Aila noticed that the parcel had been delivered to the wrong flat.
entries.zh: 艾拉注意到包裹被送错了公寓。

entries.en: Aili collected the postcards that had fallen behind the cabinet.
entries.zh: 艾利捡起了掉到柜子后面的明信片。

entries.en: An ailurophile, Priya chose the flat partly because its landlord allowed cats.
entries.zh: 普里娅极其喜爱猫，她选择那套公寓，部分原因是房东允许养猫。

entries.en: Her ailurophilia was evident in the cat portraits covering every wall.
entries.zh: 每面墙上都挂满了猫的画像，从中可以看出她的爱猫癖。

entries.en: An ailurophobe, he always chose the chair farthest from our cat.
entries.zh: 他极其讨厌猫，总是挑那把离我家猫最远的椅子坐。

entries.en: Aimar saved the cardboard boxes for the move next month.
entries.zh: 艾马尔把纸板箱留了下来，准备下个月搬家用。

entries.en: Aimi sent us a photograph of the new curtains.
entries.zh: 相见发来了一张新窗帘的照片给我们看。

entries.en: Aimin wrote the opening time on a note beside the telephone.
entries.zh: 艾曼把开门时间写在了电话旁的一张便条上。

entries.en: Aimo asked us to save a seat near the front.
entries.zh: 艾莫让我们在前排附近留个座位。

entries.meaningZh: 艾姆波音特公司〔公司名〕
entries.en: The courier called Aimpoint to ask which entrance was open.
entries.zh: 快递员给艾姆波音特公司打电话，询问哪个入口开着。

entries.en: Aina put the wet shoes on newspaper beside the door.
entries.zh: 艾娜把湿鞋放在了门旁的报纸上。

entries.en: Aini carried the folded screen upstairs with my help.
entries.zh: 艾尼在我的帮助下，把折叠屏风搬上了楼。

entries.en: Ainley fetched a fresh towel after the first one fell into the bath.
entries.zh: 第一条毛巾掉进浴缸后，安利又拿来了一条干净的。

entries.en: Several Ainus in the class volunteered to help hang the paintings.
entries.zh: 班里的几位阿伊努人自愿帮忙挂画。

entries.en: The air-conditioner rattled so loudly that we moved to another room.
entries.zh: 空调器响得太吵，我们就搬到了另一个房间。

entries.en: The air-freshener's strong scent made me open both windows.
entries.zh: 空气清香剂的浓烈气味让我打开了两扇窗。

entries.en: The museum kept the antique air-gun in a locked display case.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那支古董气枪放在上锁的展示柜里。

entries.en: We borrowed an air-pump after discovering that the bicycle tyre was flat.
entries.zh: 发现自行车轮胎瘪了之后，我们借了一个气泵。

entries.en: Aira wrapped the flowers in paper before handing them to me.
entries.zh: 艾拉先用纸包好鲜花，才把它们交给我。

entries.en: The airbed lost so much air overnight that I woke on the floor.
entries.zh: 充气床垫夜里漏了太多气，醒来时我已经躺在地板上了。

entries.en: We could fit two airbeds in the spare room if we moved the desk.
entries.zh: 如果把书桌移开，备用房间里就能放下两张充气床垫。

entries.en: The builder replaced a cracked airbrick near the bottom of the wall.
entries.zh: 建筑工人更换了靠近墙脚处的一块开裂的多孔空心砖。

entries.en: The radio interview's airdate changed twice before the producer confirmed Friday.
entries.zh: 那段广播访谈的播出日期改了两次，制作人才确定在星期五播出。

entries.en: There was no room on the airer for another wet towel.
entries.zh: 晾衣架上已经没地方再挂一条湿毛巾了。

entries.en: The airfreighter remained on the apron while the last pallets were loaded.
entries.zh: 装最后几托盘货物时，那架货运飞机仍停在停机坪上。

entries.en: Our long-exposure photograph captured airglow above the dark horizon.
entries.zh: 我们的长曝光照片拍到了黑暗地平线上方的气辉。

entries.meaningZh: 拍照航空信〔英式历史邮政用语〕
entries.en: The faded airgraph was the only letter she kept from that winter.
entries.zh: 那封褪色的拍照航空信是她从那个冬天留下的唯一一封信。

entries.en: Airolo offered to take the heavy bag while I carried the baby.
entries.zh: 艾罗洛提出拿那个沉重的包，让我抱孩子。

entries.en: The airpark's only cafe closed before our small plane arrived.
entries.zh: 我们的小飞机到达之前，那座小型民用机场唯一的咖啡馆就关门了。

entries.en: The surveyor traced the stream on an airphoto spread across the desk.
entries.zh: 测量员在铺在桌上的航空照片上描出了那条溪流。

entries.en: A leaf had become lodged inside the airscoop.
entries.zh: 一片树叶卡在了进气口里面。

entries.en: The researchers treated the valley as a single airshed when planning their measurements.
entries.zh: 研究人员规划测量时，把这条山谷当作一个空气域。

entries.en: The project compares pollution measurements from three neighbouring airsheds.
entries.zh: 这个项目比较了三个相邻空气域的污染测量数据。

entries.en: I could not tell from which airt the distant music came.
entries.zh: 我分辨不出远处的音乐是从哪个方向传来的。

entries.en: A damaged seal reduced the airtightness of the storage box.
entries.zh: 一处密封件损坏，降低了储物箱的密封性。

entries.en: Aishwarya offered me a clean apron before we started baking.
entries.zh: 开始烘焙前，艾什瓦尔雅递给我一条干净的围裙。

entries.en: A dropped shopping basket blocked the narrow aisleway beside the freezer.
entries.zh: 一个掉落的购物篮堵住了冰柜旁的狭窄走道。

entries.en: Aisling found a quiet place to practise before the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会前，爱丝琳找了个安静的地方练习。

entries.en: Aita mended the torn kite while the children watched.
entries.zh: 孩子们看着艾塔修补那个破风筝。

entries.en: She kept the Aiter packaging in case the purchase had to be returned.
entries.zh: 她留着艾德品牌的包装，以防买的东西需要退货。

entries.meaningZh: 河中小岛〔英式英语，复数〕
entries.en: Morning mist hid the aits near the bend in the river.
entries.zh: 晨雾遮住了河流转弯处附近的那些小岛。

entries.en: Aiya brought the chessboard outside after we finished lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后，艾娅把棋盘拿到了外面。

entries.en: Aizenberg wiped the rain from his glasses before reading the menu.
entries.zh: 艾森贝格先擦掉眼镜上的雨水，才开始看菜单。

entries.en: Aizenman borrowed a trolley to move the boxes from the lift.
entries.zh: 艾森曼借了一辆手推车，把箱子从电梯里搬走。

entries.en: Ajah offered to feed our cat while we were away.
entries.zh: 阿贾提出在我们外出期间帮忙喂我家的猫。

entries.en: Ajala opened the spare room when the guests decided to stay overnight.
entries.zh: 客人们决定留宿后，阿贾拉打开了备用房间。

entries.en: Ajayi replaced the burnt toast with a fresh slice.
entries.zh: 阿贾伊把烤焦的吐司换成了一片新的。

entries.en: Ajia put the damp postcards between clean sheets of paper.
entries.zh: 阿吉亚把潮湿的明信片夹在了干净的纸张之间。

entries.meaningZh: 马铃薯炖汤〔哥伦比亚菜〕
entries.en: The bowl of ajiaco was still steaming when we sat down.
entries.zh: 我们坐下时，那碗马铃薯炖汤还冒着热气。

entries.en: Ajit checked the seat pockets before we left the train.
entries.zh: 下火车前，阿吉特检查了座椅后背的口袋。

entries.en: Ajmal held the door while we carried the sleeping dog inside.
entries.zh: 我们把睡着的狗抱进屋时，阿杰马勒扶着门。

entries.en: Akagi remembered the spare charger just as we were leaving.
entries.zh: 我们正要离开时，阿卡吉想起了备用充电器。
